Can your household afford paying for a week's annual
(seven days) holiday away from home for all household
members together or separately? (Holiday village, hotel, guest
house, summer house, friend/relative house, governmental camps
are included.)

Can your household afford to cost of meal with meat,
chicken or fish every second day? (Vegetarian equivalent)

Can your household afford an unexpected required expense
(approximately 1.780 Turkish Lira) and pay through its own
resources?

Can your household afford to keep its home adequately
warm?

Do you renew your worn-out or old furniture (bed, couch,
dresser, closet) ?
(Second-hand furniture can be taken into account)
(*: Not in need of, not want to have and other reasons)

1- Yes
2- No- Finanacial difficulty
3- No- Other reasons*

Annual rental value of the dwelling according to current
market prices
(Tenure status is 'owner' or 'other' i.e. HH020 ='1' or '4' )

Income received by household members aged under 15
during 2023 (TRY)

Children related allowances in cash received during 2023
(TRY)

Value of children related allowances in kind received during
2023 (TRY)
Other social allowances in cash received in 2023 (TRY)

Value of other social allowances in kind received in 2023
(TRY)

Regular allowances in cash received from other households
or persons in 2023 (TRY)

Value of regular allowances in kind received from other
households or persons in 2023 (Excluding alimony) (TRY)

Income received from rental of assets or lands in 2023
(TRY)

Market value of animal or vegetable products not regarded
as an agricultural activity, produced just for own
consumption of household in 2023 (TRY)

Regular allowances in cash paid to other households or
persons in 2023 (Excluding alimony) (TRY)

Value of regular allowances in kind paid to other
households or persons in 2023 (TRY)

Regular taxes paid in 2023 (including tax for the dwelling,
motor vehicles tax and regularly paid wealth tax) (TRY)
(Excluding income tax)

Imputed annual income for individuals not responded to the
questionnaire

Total household disposable income (*)
(FG010 + FG020 + FG030 + FG040 + FG070 + FG080 +
FG085 + FG090 + FG100 + FG110 + FG120 + HG010 +
HG020 + HG030N + HG030A + HG040 + HG050N +
HG050A + HG060N + HG060A + HG065N + HG070 +
HG080 + HG085 + HG105 - HG090N - HG090A - HG095N
- HG100 - HG103)
(*): For the negative household disposable income, 15% of the
median income is taken.
